title: ampelocissus polystachya
intro: Ampelocissus polystachya, commonly known as Indian vine or Telugu, is a woody climber belonging to the grape family (Vitaceae). Traditionally, the plant is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ampelocissus polystachya include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
